verdict.rationale: OpenHands documents an automation that detects failed CI workflows, inspects logs, finds the likely cause and opens a pull request with a proposed fix. Automations can run in response to webhook events, and an SDK guide covers GitHub workflows. Evidence for this story is mainly marketing-level, so the depth of the pipeline trigger is unproven; missing for 10: detailed first-party setup docs for invoking the agent from a CI pipeline step (e.g., headless or non-interactive run configuration for failing-test fixes), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can trigger an agent from CI/CD pipelines to fix a broken build or failing test

citations.quote: Detect failed workflows, inspect logs, identify the likely cause, and open a pull request with a proposed fix.
Run on a schedule or in response to webhook events
API support for automation and scripting
